snap_to_obj: create a grasp by snapping a simulator object to the robot end effector with rigid constraints
desnap: remove all active hold constraints and release the currently grasped simulator object
is_violating_hold_constraint: check if the distance between the robot end effector and grasped object exceeds the hold threshold
reset: reset the grasp manager state and configure collision groups for held objects
is_grasped: check if the robot is currently grasping any simulator object
